Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

Thank you for your offer. We want to continue with you as our main source for this bar: a binding 94,800 kg per year for 24 months, 189,600 kg in total; our monthly call-off schedule is attached.

On 2026-09-10 you quoted us EUR 5.45 per kg for this bar; your new quote is 11.0% above it.
Our orders for this bar rose from EUR 5.17 to EUR 5.45 within nine months (po:4500013278-10, po:4500013392-10, po:4500013795-10, po:4500014455-10).
Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Our demand forecast for this part is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

We propose three options, all 24 months without a price adjustment clause: EUR 4.73 at 45 days net, EUR 4.70 at 14 days net, or EUR 4.78 at 90 days net.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. 

To support a 24-month agreement, we must include an AS-14404 index clause, which allows us to reduce our offer to €5.29 per kg. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.25 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a price of €5.29 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Our revised offer stands at a price of €5.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.12 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Georg Aigner
